30:25.text: And among His Signs is that the heaven and the earth stand by His Command. Then afterwards when He will call you by a single call, behold, you will come out from the earth
(i.e. from your graves for reckoning and recompense)

30:26.text: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are obedient to Him.

30:27.text: And He it is Who originates the creation, then He will repeat it
; and this is easier for Him. His is the highest description
(i.e. none has the right to be worshipped but He, and there is nothing comparable unto Him)
in the heavens and in the earth. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

30:28.text: He sets forth for you a parable from your ownselves: Do you have partners among those whom your right hands possess
to share as equals in the wealth We have bestowed on you whom you fear as you fear each other? Thus do We explain the signs in detail to a people who have sense.

30:29.text: Nay, but those who do wrong follow their own lusts without knowledge. Then who will guide him whom Allâh has sent astray? And for such there will be no helpers.

30:30.text: with which He has created mankind. No change let there be in Khalq-illâh
(i.e. the religion of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
: that is the straight religion, but most of men know not.

30:31.text: , and be afraid and dutiful to Him; and perform As-Salât
(the polytheists, idolaters, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah)

30:32.text: Of those who split up their religion
(i.e. who left the true Islâmic Monotheism)
[i.e. they invented new things in the religion (Bid‘ah ), and followed their vain desires]
, each sect rejoicing in that which is with it.
